name: Tianeptine sulfate

routes.doseReason: No source publishes a sulfate-salt ladder: the community ladders are the sodium salt's (Stablon 12.5 mg), and a 2023 review (PMC10596629) reports only an unverified 25 mg/day belief. Kept on Kiri's call pending a sulfate dose source.

effects: Mu-opioid activity; addiction and overdose risk. Banned in several US states.
Slow-release sulfate salt — longer duration than sodium
Marketed as 'Tianna' grey-market product in US
